One point only, because gene_expression is the paper's only real-data cell passing the pre-fixed gain rule and A7 does not bound it (A6 r = 0.930 vs floor ratio 0.989 at n = 100):
  > 1. Give, for gene_expression, Δ̂, σ²_res, the predicted n* and the diagnostic, and say whether the gain comes from the calibrator (nonlinear E[Y|f]/skewed Y) or from a better-calibrated Wald interval (coverage 0.951 vs PPI++'s). 
  > 2. Add a stronger, still cross-fitted, floor estimate (e.g. the flexible calibrator class A6 selects) for the 1-D sets so the "ratio at the floor" is not beaten by an arm; label it clearly as a within-class estimate.
  > Everything else needs no change to the outline. Please also tell me when the T2/B5 headline rows and the disjoint-draw cells are final.
